learning_rate_scheduler: linear warmup over 6% of steps followed by linear decay
data_aug: No external data augmentation; auxiliary supervision is generated from the BabyLM strict-small training corpus plus hand-written semantic cloze templates that do not use official evaluation items.
description: Compact BERT-style masked language model trained on BabyLM strict-small with a multi-task objective. In addition to MLM, the run uses replaced-token detection, connective prediction, definiteness prediction, collocation discrimination, grammar minimal-pair ranking, and an MLM-head semantic cloze ranking auxiliary task. The selected final model is optimized for EWoK/reading trade-offs while preserving a standard AutoModelForMaskedLM interface.
notes: GPU hours and FLOPs are approximate; epochs is set to 1 for the leaderboard form because the local setup is step-sampled multi-task training rather than a clean full-corpus epoch loop. The leaderboard form requires Total training FLOPS as an integer; 8000000000000000 is the integer-FLOP equivalent of the original 0.008 PFLOP estimate.
